expect_runner: \[motion-plan\] pointer centred in owned foreground game
purpose: SHaRC (sharc) OFF/ON/OFF on top of Ultra with gi_far 6 m (S8, the PT reference scene; static camera). Only sharc toggles live (sharc_device=1 at startup). diag-on: rt_stats + sharc_stats (GI far line, cache found share). Cost OFF/ON/OFF without diagnostics, one PNG trace per state, exposure held from cost-off-a. Prediction in predicted.json (committed before the run). No gi_debug views: they pause the injection, and the cache clears after 8 frames without it. Then gi_rr_rays 2/1/2 under the same Ultra + gi_far (sharc 0): cost-rays-* 20 s, shot-rays-* 10 s with 3 traces each (energy: m4_promotion_gate view shot-rays; flicker: rays_flicker.py, the QA temporal detector on the final frame).
